DESIGN_NOTE: M5 brain-mechanism cell: reverse-replay / backward sweep. Tests whether SEPARATE reverse-temporal-order store (S_back) lifts substrate multi-hop accuracy over forward-only baseline (arm A). Includes M3 bidirectional meet-in-middle composition (arm D), reward-gated reverse-replay (arm E; Ambrose-Pfeiffer-Foster 2016), and a CRITICAL discriminator (arm F: shuffled-temporal-order reverse-replay) that tests whether temporal order is load-bearing — distinguishing 'reverse-replay helps because of TEMPORAL ORDER' (HARD_PASS) vs 'any extra replay helps regardless of order' (HARD_FAIL or MIDDLE). Companion to META_M7 bidirectional cell (which uses W.T; this cell uses separate S_back so forward and reverse can be selectively gated).
